# netskope_aig_rate_limit_list (Data Source)

Lists all rate limit rules configured in the Netskope AI Gateway tenant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netskope_aig_rate_limit_list" "my_aigratelimitlist" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `elements` (Attributes List) List of rate limit rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--elements))

<a id="nestedatt--elements"></a>
### Nested Schema for `elements`

Read-Only:

- `appliance_ids` (List of String) Appliance IDs this rule applies to (empty means all appliances).
- `criteria` (Attributes) Matching criteria for the rate limit rule. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--elements--criteria))
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the rate limit rule.
- `limit` (Attributes) Rate limit threshold (requests per time unit, per appliance). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--elements--limit))
- `name` (String) Name of the rate limit rule.
- `response` (String) Custom message returned when the rate limit is exceeded.

<a id="nestedatt--elements--criteria"></a>
### Nested Schema for `elements.criteria`

Read-Only:

- `ai_provider_ids` (List of String) AI provider IDs to match. Only valid when `apply_on` is `ai`.
Currently supports at most one provider per rule.
- `apply_on` (String) Whether the rate limit applies to `ai` (AI provider) or `mcp` (MCP server) traffic.
- `mcp_server_ids` (List of String) MCP server IDs to match. Only valid when `apply_on` is `mcp`.
Currently supports at most one server per rule.
- `models` (Attributes List) AI model name patterns to match. Only valid when `apply_on` is `ai`.
Maximum 100 entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--elements--criteria--models))
- `prompts` (Attributes List) MCP prompt name patterns to match. Only valid when `apply_on` is `mcp`.
Maximum 100 entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--elements--criteria--prompts))
- `resources` (Attributes List) MCP resource URI patterns to match. Only valid when `apply_on` is `mcp`.
Maximum 100 entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--elements--criteria--resources))
- `token_group_ids` (List of String) Token group IDs to match against. Empty means all token groups.
- `tools` (Attributes List) MCP tool name patterns to match. Only valid when `apply_on` is `mcp`.
Maximum 100 entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--elements--criteria--tools))

<a id="nestedatt--elements--criteria--models"></a>
### Nested Schema for `elements.criteria.models`

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) Match type. Currently only `exact` (case-sensitive full match) is supported.
- `value` (String) Value to match against.


<a id="nestedatt--elements--criteria--prompts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `elements.criteria.prompts`

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) Match type. Currently only `exact` (case-sensitive full match) is supported.
- `value` (String) Value to match against.


<a id="nestedatt--elements--criteria--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `elements.criteria.resources`

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) Match type. Currently only `exact` (case-sensitive full match) is supported.
- `value` (String) Value to match against.


<a id="nestedatt--elements--criteria--tools"></a>
### Nested Schema for `elements.criteria.tools`

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) Match type. Currently only `exact` (case-sensitive full match) is supported.
- `value` (String) Value to match against.



<a id="nestedatt--elements--limit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `elements.limit`

Read-Only:

- `requests` (Number) Maximum number of requests allowed per time unit per appliance.
- `unit` (String) Time unit for the rate limit window.
